senses.gloss:
ह्वृ ह्वृ or ह्वॄ (originally ध्वृ, q. v.;
cf. rts. हुर्छ्, ह्रु), cl. 1. P. ह्वरति, जह्-
वार, ह्वरिष्यति, अह्वार्षीत् (Ved. अह्वार्), ह्वर्-
तुम्, cl. 9. P. ह्वृणाति, &c., to be crooked or curved,
go crookedly; to be crooked in conduct, deceive;
to be injured or afflicted; (according to Naigh. II. 8)
to eat: Caus. ह्वारयति, &c., to make crooked,
bend, curve; to hurt, injure: Desid. जुह्वूर्षति:
Intens. जाह्वर्यते, जाह्वर्ति; [cf. Gr. κυπτός,
κύρβεις, ἐρέφω: Lat. curvus, varus: Goth. hvair-
ban: Angl. Sax. hwearfian, hwerfa, hweorfan,
hwealf, hwealfa: Hib. fiar, ‘crooked;’ fiaraim,
‘I incline, bend;’ fiaras, ‘crookedness.’]
ह्वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, curved; injured, hurt.
